skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and content of product management, from product portfolio management to product lifecycle management and new product development.
Understand the content, basis, and requirements for managing product quality, new product development, and product lifecycle management.
Develop and present new product plans in group projects, practicing teamwork, presentation, and professional communication skills.
Apply marketing knowledge to solve problems in product management, integrating economic and business management knowledge.
Identify and solve problems related to product quality, packaging, and brand management.
Manage and execute projects related to product development and lifecycle stages.
Demonstrate leadership in group projects, managing tasks and responsibilities effectively.
Effectively present and defend new product plans and marketing strategies.
Conduct research and analyze data related to product development and market trends.
Make informed decisions in product management, considering various factors and market conditions.
